resource.name: VanBobby FireRed Theme
resource.description: FireRed theme, in progress. Every window, button, tab and input is repainted in FireRed's cream-and-gold window grammar with scanlined fills, text carries FireRed's hard 1px drop shadow, and the login screen carries a painted backdrop and title plate. 0.24 gives the bag its gold list panel, pocket tabs and open-pocket underline, the trainer card its blue header, scanlined body and badge row, and the dex its taupe frame.
resource.author: carlospinan
